faqs.question: How do I know this is the right variant for my Envy x360 14-fc?
faqs.answer: The 14-fc series ships with two different touch panels: WUXGA IPS (this listing) and 2.8K OLED. Send us your full model number (e.g. 14-fc0009na) or a photo of the label under your laptop on WhatsApp and we'll confirm which one you need before you order.

faqs.question: Is it touch screen?
faqs.answer: Yes, this is a multi-touch IPS panel with Corning Gorilla Glass NBT protection, matching the Envy x360's 360-degree convertible hinge.

faqs.question: What warranty comes with this screen?
faqs.answer: This screen carries a 3-month warranty against dead pixels and panel defects.
